newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan poltician shot near Colombian border.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan poltician shot near Colombian border.

text.p: A Venezuelan politician was shot and killed on Friday near the Colombian border as he tried to escape the clutches of four armed kidnappers, the National Guard said.

Gonzalo Carvajal, 42, a local councilor in western Tachira state, was shot at dawn during a kidnap attempt by presumed Colombian guerrillas in the town of Urena, 530 miles (850 km) south west of Caracas.
Carvajal's death is the latest in a series of kidnappings and guerrilla incidents on Venezuela's 1,400 mile (2,200 km) border with Colombia that have strained relations between the two countries.
